description: Pocket SDR receiver for Cardputer Zero: spectrum, waterfall, FM/NFM/AM/USB/LSB audio, ADSB aircraft, AIS vessels, ACARS messages, APRS stations and an RFI survey page. Requires an RTL-SDR USB dongle and an antenna.

store.summary: Pocket SDR receiver: spectrum, waterfall, audio, ADSB, AIS, ACARS, APRS and RFI
store.description:
ZeroSDR turns the Cardputer Zero into a pocket SDR receiver.

FEATURES
- Spectrum, waterfall and FM/NFM/AM/USB/LSB audio on the 320x170 display
- Wideband spectrum page and RFI survey (10m/20m/40m/80m)
- ADSB: aircraft list, PFD detail view and a radar with a map background
- AIS: vessel list, map PPI with a CPA guard ring, ship dossier and console
- APRS: receive-only 1200 baud AFSK/AX.25, station list, map, detail and packet console
- NMEA 0183 UDP 10110 output for OpenCPN / Signal K
- On-screen key reference (H); Fn+P saves a screenshot on every page

REQUIRED HARDWARE
- An RTL-SDR USB dongle (tested with RTL-SDR Blog V4 / RTL2832U)
- An antenna: VHF/UHF for SDR, AIS and APRS, 1090 MHz for ADSB
- The dongle plugs into the USB-A port and is powered by the device

NOTES
- Runs as the normal user; the package installs its own udev rules
- ADSB decoding uses the bundled readsb, no separate install
- APRS is receive-only; RTL-SDR hardware cannot transmit
- Audio plays through the built-in speaker or the 3.5 mm jack

zh-CN.summary: RTL-SDR 口袋 SDR：频谱、瀑布、解调、ADSB、AIS、ACARS、APRS 与 RFI
zh-CN.description:
ZeroSDR 把 Cardputer Zero 变成一台口袋 SDR 接收机。

功能
- 320×170 屏幕上的频谱、瀑布与 FM/NFM/AM/USB/LSB 解调
- 宽带频谱页与 RFI 底噪对比（10m/20m/40m/80m）
- ADSB：飞机列表、PFD 详情页和带地图的雷达视图
- AIS：船舶列表、带 CPA 警戒圈的地图 PPI、船舶档案页和报文控制台
- APRS：只收 1200 baud AFSK/AX.25，站点列表、地图、详情和报文控制台
- NMEA 0183 UDP 10110 输出，可接入 OpenCPN / Signal K
- 屏幕按键说明（H）；Fn+P 在任意页面截图

需要的硬件
- RTL-SDR USB 电视棒（已验证 RTL-SDR Blog V4 / RTL2832U）
- 一根天线：SDR/AIS/APRS 用 VHF/UHF 天线，ADSB 用 1090 MHz 天线
- 电视棒插在 USB-A 口，由设备供电

说明
- 以普通用户运行；安装包自带 udev 规则
- ADSB 解码使用随包安装的 readsb，无需另外安装
- APRS 只收不发；RTL-SDR 硬件不能发射
- 音频通过内置扬声器或 3.5 mm 耳机口输出
